verdict.rationale: Extend documents its own OCR capability: "Agentic OCR" in its parsing features, image inputs (PNG/JPG/TIFF) that photographed and scanned documents arrive as, and handwriting detection. It also claims accuracy on its "hardest documents", and one customer reports being happy with extraction accuracy. Nothing in the evidence addresses the story's specific hard cases. Missing for 10: documented handling of skewed or rotated pages, stamps and seals, and low-quality or noisy scans; independent or hands-on corroboration of OCR accuracy on degraded scans or photos.

support.subject: As a developer, scanned and photographed documents OCR accurately — skewed pages, stamps, low quality scans included
